name: Postscript
tagline: Celebration cakes in Bath, written by hand.
taxNote: No VAT is shown because none is charged: cakes are zero-rated in the UK, and everything we sell is a cake.
_card: The physical stock, and the two hands. perLine is how many characters fit across the card; lines is how many the card holds. Writing smaller buys both. A merchant with different stock changes these two numbers and the whole preview follows.

card.stock: A6, folded, letterpressed with our mark
card.note: Written in ink, by whoever is on the bench that morning. No charge — it is a card.

_keptDates: The occasion layer. This browser only; see docs/03-romantic-boutique.md §5. The template never claims it can send anything.

keptDates.note: Kept on this device, in this browser. We cannot email you about it, and we will not pretend otherwise.

delivery.note: Driven by us, boxed flat, inside the city and the villages around it.

allergenStatement: Two rooms, one oven, and gluten, dairy, egg, nuts and soya in the air of both. Nothing leaves here certified free of any of them. Tell us what the person opening it cannot eat and we will say what is possible before you choose a cake.

voice.headline: Someone is about to open this.
voice.lede: We make celebration cakes and write on them by hand. Pick the cake, write the card, and watch it set in the hand it will be written in while you are still deciding.

gifting.note: Prices come off everything in the box as a matter of course. You do not have to ask.
